notes.title: Jumping is here!
notes.content:
[h2] JUMPING IS HERE[/h2]

[p]Hello everyone! Sigyaad here with a small but very important update to IAS 2!   Jumping is now implemented! Yipieeee!! The game should feel much better to play now!   

Also, map 3 has been remade to be easier to follow (for instance, you can't fall to the floor anymore, and if you fall down from the sides you get teleported to a checkpoint.)

Additionally, i've adjusted some of the collision boxes on the outdoor levels, it should hopefully be a lot harder to go out of bounds now.

[h2]FIXED BOSSES COMING TOMORROW[/h2]

I'm hard at work on the game! I'm gonna get some sleep and then tomorrow i'll work on and hopefully release an update that will fix the bosses being way too easy! I'll aim to release an update every day! 

And of course, there's much more planned for the game! Right now the goal is to implement some important features and fixes (stronger bosses, new dash attack, weapon altfires, adjust hitboxes, etc) then it'll be off to killing as many single bugs as I can! Afterwards I'll focus on adding more content [/p]

notes.title: I'm listening to all your feedback!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After checking out all of your feedback (and crying over it), I'm comitted to making this game better! 

Some of the fixes and features I'll be implementing [b]soon[/b] include, but aren't limited to: 

[list]
[*] -New altfire for the shotgun
[*] -Jumping! 
[*] -Killing many, many bugs! 
[*] -Reworking level 3! Never again will you have to  fall through the map! 
[*] -Changing the dash so it's now an attack! 
[*] -Bosses will be stronger! 
[/list]


After these critical issues have been addressed, I'll be refining the gameplay and visuals so that the game can be as best as it can be! These will include, but not limited too 

[list]
[*] -New enemy types! 
[*] -Better visuals on the maps! 
[*] -More altfires! (I'm thinking iron sights for the p90!) 
[/list]

Again, really sorry for the bugs and whatnot! I promise I'll make this game better and will do better in subsequent game releases! For those who still find the game enjoyable despite it's bugs, thanks so much! I really appreciate it! And for those who hadn't had a good expereince, I hope you'll be willing to give this game another chance after some updates!
